_comment: The resolved lifecycle edges of the documents in this directory, as one resolver must read them: `parent` is the single typed relation (analysis_id for a plan, plan_id for a task file), `children` the reverse of it. Both cli/cmd (context_cascade_test.go) and web (src/lib/edges.test.ts) assert this file, so the Go resolver and the viewer payload cannot disagree about who derives from whom. A `sources` or `links` citation is never an edge.

context/analysis/normal.md._comment: the citing plan derives from this analysis; the sibling it also cites does not

context/analysis/sibling.md._comment: cited by plan/citing.md in sources, but not its parent: no edge

context/plan/dangling.md._comment: analysis_id resolves to no document: no parent

context/tasks/linked.md._comment: links a plan without plan_id: no edge
